plans.note: Outline exposes only the preamble of this Master Services Agreement, so the full body must be scanned within sec-preamble. An MSA of this type almost always carries a limitation of liability article; check for mutuality, a cap tied to fees paid, and carve-outs for indemnity, confidentiality, IP infringement and willful misconduct.

Look inside sec-preamble for a Vendor indemnity covering third-party IP claims, breach of confidentiality and negligence/willful misconduct, and confirm any Customer-side indemnity is narrow. Flag as missing only if no indemnity language appears anywhere in the body.

Presence-type rule; nothing in the visible outline suggests restrictive covenants on our business lines. Scan sec-preamble for any 'exclusive dealings', 'competing products' or restrictive-covenant wording before concluding absence.
No exclusivity heading surfaces in the outline. Check the scope/services and term language in sec-preamble for sole-source or 'exclusive provider' phrasing binding us.

Direction rule: MFN obligations are uncommon in a standard MSA preamble-only outline. Search pricing/fee text in sec-preamble for 'most favoured'/'best terms' language and only flag if the obligation runs against us.

Non-solicitation clauses frequently sit near confidentiality or general provisions; review sec-preamble for duration, scope (employees actually engaged) and a general-advertising carve-out, and confirm it binds both parties rather than us alone.

The defined term 'Initial Term' indicates a term-and-termination article inside sec-preamble. Check whether we may terminate for convenience on reasonable notice without penalty and whether the Vendor holds a reciprocal mid-term exit.
'Initial Term' strongly implies renewal mechanics in sec-preamble. Assess auto-renewal length, the non-renewal notice window and any uncapped price uplift on renewal.

Governing law and venue will sit in the general/miscellaneous provisions within sec-preamble. Confirm the law is New York, Delaware, California or England and Wales and that disputes go to courts rather than foreign arbitration.

Check the miscellaneous provisions in sec-preamble for assignment: we need affiliate and successor assignment without consent, and the Vendor should not gain a termination right on our change of control.

Direction rule: locate the intellectual property / ownership article in sec-preamble and confirm we retain our pre-existing IP and Customer Data and own paid-for deliverables; flag any assignment or broad licence of our data running to the Vendor.
Review any licence grant in sec-preamble for scope: it should extend to our affiliates and contractors and must not be revocable at the Vendor's discretion.
Audit rights, if present, will appear in the fees or compliance text of sec-preamble. Test frequency, advance notice, off-site/remote conduct and who bears cost absent a material shortfall.

Direction rule: service credits in our favour are fine and should not be flagged. Scan fees/termination text in sec-preamble for early-termination fees or liquidated damages payable by us before concluding absence.

Look for a services warranty in sec-preamble: professional and workmanlike performance for a meaningful period with re-performance or refund as the remedy, and check for a broad AS-IS disclaimer that guts it.

Insurance obligations are often placed near indemnity in an MSA body; search sec-preamble for commercial general liability, professional liability/E&O and cyber coverage with certificate and additional-insured mechanics.

No fee schedule is visible in the outline. Check the payment terms in sec-preamble for take-or-pay, minimum volume or shortfall true-up language; only flag if a commitment exists without a proportionate exit.

Review the effects-of-termination text in sec-preamble for return or export of our data in a usable format, a deletion certificate and reasonable transition assistance at agreed rates; treat as missing only if wind-down obligations are wholly absent.
